NDBC standard meteorological files and the active station list (US Government
work, public domain), recorded with curl from https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov on
2026-10-15 between 23:02Z and 23:05Z; no key is involved. Station 41002 (South
Hatteras) has files from 1973 to now; 42040 (Luke Offshore Test Platform) is
the station Tropical Storm Arlene passed in June 2005. Times in the files are
UTC.

H = /data/historical/stdmet/, S = /data/stdmet/, R = /data/realtime2/.

Byte for byte, as served (Content-Type application/x-gzip, no
Content-Encoding; each a single gzip member):
  41002h1973.txt.gz       H 41002h1973.txt.gz. One header line "YY MM DD hh
                          WD ... VIS": two-digit years, no minute column,
                          no TIDE; WD and BAR are the old names. 461 rows.
  4100212026.txt.gz       S Jan/4100212026.txt.gz: January 2026, a finalized
                          month of the current year (month digit 1). Two
                          header lines, units row with VIS "nmi" and MWD
                          "deg" (not "degT"); 9-filled missing values. 4464
                          rows.

Trimmed (the first lines of the decompressed file, byte for byte, LF line
ends as served; nothing else changed):
  41002h1996.txt          H 41002h1996.txt.gz, header and 12 rows: two-digit
                          years of the 1990s; a WSPD written ".7".
  41002h1999.txt          H 41002h1999.txt.gz, header and 12 rows: header
                          "YYYY", four-digit years, no minute column; the
                          first row is missing in every column (999, 99.0,
                          99.00, 9999.0 BAR, 999.0). Its rows end in CRLF,
                          its header line in LF, as served.
  41002h2001.txt          H 41002h2001.txt.gz, header and 6 rows: TIDE
                          appears, still no minute column.
  41002h2005.txt          H 41002h2005.txt.gz, header and 6 rows: one header
                          line with the minute column "mm".
  41002h2007.txt          H 41002h2007.txt.gz, two header lines and 6 rows:
                          "#YY" header and "#yr" units row, whose VIS unit is
                          "nmi" in this historical file (2019's says "mi").
  41002h2019.txt          H 41002h2019.txt.gz, two header lines and 6 rows,
                          10-minute rows ending in a space; VIS "mi".
  Sep_41002.txt           S Sep/41002.txt, two header lines and 12 rows: the
                          latest month not yet finalized on 2026-10-15
                          (Content-Type text/plain; charset=ISO-8859-1,
                          uncompressed; "Oct/" was empty). Units row as the
                          monthly files (nmi, deg); 9-filled.
  41002_realtime2.txt     R 41002.txt (upper-case id), the two header lines,
                          the first 12 rows and the last 2 (6465 lines in
                          all). Newest first; "MM" for missing values; PTDY
                          with an explicit sign ("+1.3", "-0.0"). The newest
                          row was 2026-10-03 16:50, twelve days old.

Selected rows (header line 1, then lines 3443-3446 and 3844-3850 of the
decompressed file, byte for byte; the rows stay in time order):
  42040h2005_arlene.txt   H 42040h2005.txt.gz: a 9999.0 BAR row (missing) on
                          2005-05-25 17:00, and Arlene's 2005-06-11 rows with
                          real pressures 999.2, 999.0 (twice), 998.6, 999.3
                          hPa: 999.0 hPa is data, not a sentinel (v4 bug L12).

Facts the full list shows (2026-10-15): every station element is
self-closing on its own line; no non-ASCII byte; entities &amp; (8) and
&quot; (8) only; 743 lower-case ids; 36 ids of four characters and 18 of
seven digits (NDBC ids since plan decision 38, 2026-10-16); 264 stations
without elev; 48 TAO buoys without the four feed flags; 41002 and 42040 have
met="n" although both serve standard met files.
